title: Summarize the excerpt from 'EchoSystems Chrono Compendium v1.0' (chunk 1.14) about time: e Egyptians appear to have been the ﬁrst to develop a solar calendar,[27] using as a ﬁxed point the annual sunrise reap
prompt: Summarize the excerpt from 'EchoSystems Chrono Compendium v1.0' (chunk 1.14) about time: e Egyptians appear to have been the ﬁrst to develop a solar calendar,[27] using as a ﬁxed point the annual sunrise reap
true_answer: e Egyptians appear to have been the ﬁrst to develop a solar calendar,[27] using as a ﬁxed point the annual sunrise reappearance of the Dog Star—Sirius, or Sothis—in the eastern sky, which coincided with the annual ﬂooding of the Nile River.[28][29][30] ey built a calendar with 365 days, divided into 12 months of 30 days each, with 5 extra days at the end of the year.
